computer.content:
import os
sys = __import__('sys')
import subprocess
import glob
import re

print("Starting build_video script...")

# Step 1: Parse and shift SRT files
def parse_srt(filepath):
    if not os.path.exists(filepath):
        return []
    with open(filepath, 'r', encoding='utf-8', errors='ignore') as f:
        content = f.read()
    pattern = re.compile(r'(\d+)\n(\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3}) --> (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2},\d{3})\n(.*?)(?:\n\n|\Z)', re.DOTALL)
    subs = []
    for match in pattern.finditer(content):
        idx, start, end, text = match.groups()
        subs.append((parse_time(start), parse_time(end), text.strip()))
    return subs

def parse_time(t_str):
    h, m, s_ms = t_str.split(':')
    s, ms = s_ms.split(',')
    return int(h)*3600 + int(m)*60 + int(s) + int(ms)/1000.0

def format_time(seconds):
    if seconds < 0: seconds = 0
    h = int(seconds // 3600)
    m = int((seconds % 3600) // 60)
    s = int(seconds % 60)
    ms = int(round((seconds - int(seconds)) * 1000))
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d},{ms:03d}"

# Define segments: (clip_path, srt_path, trim_start, trim_end, timeline_start)
# Total timeline: 120 seconds
# 0.0 - 10.0: Title card
# 10.0 - 35.0: Clip 1 (Astrobee launch, 25s, trim 1.0 to 26.0) -> offset shift: 10.0 - 1.0 = +9.0s
# 35.0 - 60.0: Clip 2 (ISAAC Astrobee, 25s, trim 0.0 to 25.0) -> offset shift: 35.0 - 0.0 = +35.0s
# 60.0 - 85.0: Clip 3 (Starling Mission, 25s, trim 0.0 to 25.0) -> offset shift: 60.0 - 0.0 = +60.0s
# 85.0 - 110.0: Clip 4 (EELS / Tech, 25s, trim 10.0 to 35.0) -> offset shift: 85.0 - 10.0 = +75.0s
# 110.0 - 120.0: Closing card

segments = [
    {
        "type": "title",
        "duration": 10.0,
        "title": "AI TECHNOLOGY",
        "subtitle": "Autonomous Robotics & Space Exploration"
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "video": "clips/ARC_20190417_AAV3189_AstrobeeLaunch_Shar.mp4",
        "srt": "clips/ARC_20190417_AAV3189_AstrobeeLaunch_Shar.srt",
        "ss": 1.0,
        "to": 26.0,
        "timeline_start": 10.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "video": "clips/ARC_20210810_AAV3354_ISAAC_Astrobee_NASA.mp4",
        "srt": "clips/ARC_20210810_AAV3354_ISAAC_Astrobee_NASA.srt",
        "ss": 0.0,
        "to": 25.0,
        "timeline_start": 35.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "video": "clips/ARC_20230712_AAV3483_StarlingMission_Ove.mp4",
        "srt": "clips/ARC_20230712_AAV3483_StarlingMission_Ove.srt",
        "ss": 0.0,
        "to": 25.0,
        "timeline_start": 60.0
    },
    {
        "type": "clip",
        "video": "clips/JPL_20240508_EELSf_0002_Testing_Out_JPLs.mp4",
        "srt": "clips/JPL_20240508_EELSf_0002_Testing_Out_JPLs.srt",
        "ss": 10.0,
        "to": 35.0,
        "timeline_start": 85.0
    },
    {
        "type": "closing",
        "duration": 10.0,
        "title": "EXPLORING THE FUTURE",
        "subtitle": "Created with NASA & JPL Robotics Footage\nExported as AI_Technology.mp4"
    }
]

unified_subs = []
sub_index = 1

# Add title card subtitle
unified_subs.append((0.5, 9.5, "AI TECHNOLOGY\nAutonomous Robotics & Space Exploration"))

for seg in segments:
    if seg["type"] == "clip":
        subs = parse_srt(seg["srt"])
        ss = seg["ss"]
        to = seg["to"]
        t_start = seg["timeline_start"]
        shift = t_start - ss
        for start, end, text in subs:
            # check if subtitle falls within [ss, to]
            if end >= ss and start <= to:
                new_start = start + shift
                new_end = end + shift
                # clamp to segment bounds
                if new_start < t_start: new_start = t_start
                if new_end > t_start + (to - ss): new_end = t_start + (to - ss)
                if new_end > new_start:
                    unified_subs.append((new_start, new_end, text))

# Add closing card subtitle
unified_subs.append((110.5, 119.5, "AI TECHNOLOGY\nProject Completed Successfully"))

# Write unified SRT
with open("AI_Technology.srt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for i, (start, end, text) in enumerate(unified_subs, 1):
        f.write(f"{i}\n{format_time(start)} --> {format_time(end)}\n{text}\n\n")

print(f"Generated unified SRT with {len(unified_subs)} entries.")

# Step 2: Process individual segments into normalized intermediate video files (1280x720, 30fps)
inter_files = []

for i, seg in enumerate(segments):
    out_name = f"inter_{i}.mp4"
    inter_files.append(out_name)
    if seg["type"] == "title":
        # Generate title card video with silent audio
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "color=c=0x0a0f1d:s=1280x720:r=30:d=10",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo",
            "-filter_complex",
            "[0:v]drawtext=text='AI TECHNOLOGY':fontcolor=white:fontsize=56:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2-30:fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf,"
            "drawtext=text='Autonomous Robotics & Space Exploration':fontcolor=0x38bdf8:fontsize=26:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2+30:fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf[v]",
            "-map", "[v]", "-map", "1:a", "-t", "10",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "21", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", out_name
        ]
    elif seg["type"] == "closing":
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "color=c=0x0a0f1d:s=1280x720:r=30:d=10",
            "-f", "lavfi", "-i", "anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo",
            "-filter_complex",
            "[0:v]drawtext=text='EXPLORING THE FUTURE':fontcolor=white:fontsize=50:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2-30:fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf,"
            "drawtext=text='AI_Technology.mp4 - Exported Successfully':fontcolor=0x38bdf8:fontsize=24:x=(w-text_w)/2:y=(h-text_h)/2+30:fontfile=/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf[v]",
            "-map", "[v]", "-map", "1:a", "-t", "10",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "21", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", out_name
        ]
    else:
        duration = seg["to"] - seg["ss"]
        cmd = [
            "ffmpeg", "-y",
            "-ss", str(seg["ss"]),
            "-to", str(seg["to"]),
            "-i", seg["video"],
            "-filter_complex",
            "[0:v]scale=1280:720:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1280:720:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2,fps=30,eq=contrast=1.1:saturation=1.15:brightness=0.02[v];"
            "[0:a]aformat=sample_rates=44100:channel_layouts=stereo,volume=1.2[a]",
            "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]",
            "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "21", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", out_name
        ]
    print(f"Running segment {i}: {seg['type']}")
    res = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    if res.returncode != 0:
        print(f"Error in segment {i}:", res.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

print("All intermediate segments generated successfully.")

# Step 3: Concatenate segments
concat_list_path = "concat_list.txt"
with open(concat_list_path, "w") as f:
    for fname in inter_files:
        f.write(f"file '{fname}'\n")

concat_out = "combined_raw.mp4"
concat_cmd = [
    "ffmpeg", "-y", "-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", concat_list_path,
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "21", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
    "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", concat_out
]
res = subprocess.run(concat_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
if res.returncode != 0:
    print("Error in concat:", res.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("Concat completed successfully.")

# Step 4: Burn in subtitles and export final AI_Technology.mp4
# Using subtitles filter. In ffmpeg, colons in filename/path on Windows need escaping, but on Linux 'AI_Technology.srt' is fine.
final_cmd = [
    "ffmpeg", "-y", "-i", concat_out,
    "-vf", "subtitles=AI_Technology.srt:force_style='FontSize=22,PrimaryColour=&H00FFFFFF,OutlineColour=&H00000000,BorderStyle=1,Outline=1,Shadow=1,Alignment=2'",
    "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "21", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
    "-c:a", "copy",
    "AI_Technology.mp4"
]
res = subprocess.run(final_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
if res.returncode != 0:
    print("Error in final burn-in:", res.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

print("Final AI_Technology.mp4 exported successfully!")

# Step 5: Save editable project file (JSON)
import json
project_data = {
    "project_name": "AI_Technology_Edit",
    "resolution": [1280, 720],
    "fps": 30,
    "total_duration": 120.0,
    "segments": segments,
    "subtitles_file": "AI_Technology.srt",
    "output_file": "AI_Technology.mp4"
}
with open("AI_Technology_project.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(project_data, f, indent=2)

print("Saved project file AI_Technology_project.json")
EOF
